entries.02192d653500799d: This business arranges access to various Japanese services for foreign visitors to Japan and foreign residents in Japan. It operates the Lifetech Service, which provides living support such as real estate and medical services, and the Mobility Tech Service, which arranges Shinkansen and expressway bus tickets and airport transfers, and receives advertising fees and arrangement fees from partner companies. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥1,236 million.

entries.1ae1acaa6ac14177: This service supports foreigners’ travel within Japan, including the Shinkansen ticket arrangement service “Japan Bullet Train,” the expressway bus ticket arrangement service “Japan Bus Tickets,” and the airport transfer referral service “Airport Taxi.” It began rolling out this service in the fiscal year ended September 2024.
entries.1fb55b3cda824c9f: This business owns campervans in Japan and rents them to inbound foreign visitors and Japanese customers. It also arranges campervan rentals in the United States, Canada, Australia and New Zealand for Japanese customers. As of September 2025, it owned 34 campervans in Japan, and in the fiscal year ended September 2025 it also began selling used campervans. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥122 million.
